body:
Replacing a Google Doc from Markdown can delete native content that the Markdown export omits or flattens. `write` and `push` now refuse known lossy replacements with exit 3 before the destructive API call, naming the detected content and the explicit `--allow-lossy` opt-in.

- `write --tab NAME` inspects only the selected tab BODY, using the same snapshot and revision as its replacement batch. Rich sibling/child tabs, headers, footers, and unreferenced object metadata cannot block it; blank selected tabs remain writable.
- Whole-document `write` and `push` count tabs and inspect native content from one shared snapshot of the entire Docs response, including nested tabs and headers/footers/footnotes, after existing no-op returns. `--force` remains conflict bypass only; `--force-collapse-tabs` and `--allow-lossy` require separate consent.
- Automatic sync applies the same whole-document guard without an override. Refusals and failed safety reads are reported to stderr before upload; other hook failures are also reported while preserving the non-blocking exit.
- README documents the hazard inventory against actual Docs structures and current Markdown capabilities. Ordinary formatting and unrelated metadata are allowed. Help and CHANGELOG describe the refusal and opt-in.

Validation: 232 focused tests passed; all 1,667 tests passed; `scripts/check-no-stubs.sh` passed. The new mocked cases cover exact scope, blank targets with rich siblings, whole-document scope, no-op, opt-in, read failures, and mutation methods never being called on refusal. `ruff check gdoc/ tests/` reports the same 196 pre-existing findings as `origin/main`, with no added findings; the new modules and sync-hook tests pass ruff.

The guard covers known structures exposed by the Docs API, not pixel-perfect formatting. Whole-document Drive upload retains its existing concurrency limitation: inspection is a preflight read, whereas tab replacement uses a revision-pinned batch.

Based directly on `origin/main`. The substantive commit is recorded in `REPLICATE.md` by a metadata-only follow-up commit. No private campaign files or evidence are included.
title: Refuse lossy Markdown replacement within the exact write scope
